_comment: Small committed fixture with a real .idx.oft spanning many pages (1500 headwords / STRIDE 32 = ~47 OFT entries). Used by DictEngineTest to exercise the OFT page-boundary binary search in Dictionary::findSimilar for target words far past offset 0. Tiny definitions keep the generated dict well under ~30 KB.

meta.author: CrossPoint Test Suite
meta.description: Multi-page synthetic dictionary for fuzzy-search OFT binary-search tests.
